data_description.device: Only Mowers set up by a supported integration are listed.

confirm.description: Add {mower} to Mowing Director. Debug recording is on by default and stores Mower telemetry locally; review it in the Mowing Director panel.

data_description.device: Pick the Mower to bind to. Zones are matched by name, so your Plans are kept.

abort.already_in_progress: This is already being configured. Finish the existing configuration before starting again.
abort.no_supported_mower: No Mammotion Mower found. Add the Mammotion integration and make sure the Mower is online first.
abort.run_active: A Run is in progress. Finish or abort it before changing the Mower.

error.no_supported_mower: That device no longer has a usable Mower entity.

missing_zones.title: Zones missing from the Mower's map

init.title: Zones missing from the Mower's map
init.description: These Zones no longer match anything on the Mower's map: {zones}. Delete them and their Plans, or wait if the map is being rebuilt.

menu_options.delete: Delete these Zones and their Plans

abort.waiting: Nothing changed. The Zones stay marked missing until they return.

missing_zones.description: These Zones no longer match anything on the Mower's map: {zones}.

native_schedule.title: The Mower's own schedule is enabled
native_schedule.description: These tasks in the Mower's own schedule are enabled and may start mowing outside the director's control: {tasks}.

init.title: The Mower's own schedule is enabled

disable.title: Disable the Mower's own tasks?
disable.description: This turns off these tasks on the Mower itself: {tasks}. Confirm to continue.

abort.ignored: Nothing changed. Dismiss the issue to hide it.

conflicting_automations.title: Automations also use the Mower
conflicting_automations.description: {count} automation(s) reference the Mower's device or entities and may act on it. Mowing Director never edits automations. Dismiss this if that is intended; it returns only if the set changes.

device_not_found.title: The Mower's device was not found
device_not_found.description: The device for {mower} is gone, for example after the Mammotion entry was re-added. Open Mowing Director in Settings and choose Reconfigure to rebind it. Your Zones, Plans and settings are kept.

source_too_old.title: Mammotion integration is too old
source_too_old.description: Mammotion {version} is older than the supported {minimum}. Mowing Director may misbehave; update the Mammotion integration.

store_unusable.title: Saved state could not be read
store_unusable.description: The saved Schedule and Run state for {mower} could not be read, so the Schedule was reset to idle and empty. Mowing Director did not command the Mower or adopt any job it is running. Zones and settings are kept; add your Plans again.

no_zone_sync.message: This Mower has no adapter attached yet.

unknown_entry.message: No loaded Mower has that config_entry_id.

entry_ambiguous.message: More than one Mower is loaded; pass config_entry_id.

unknown_zone.message: No Zone is called or has the id "{zone}".

ambiguous_zone.message: More than one Zone is called "{zone}"; pass its id.

invalid_position.message: Position must be end or front, not "{position}".

run_not_pending.message: Run "{run_id}" has started or finished; only pending Runs can be changed.

move_not_pending.message: Run "{run_id}" has started or finished; only pending Runs can be moved.

move_bad_position.message: That position is outside the pending Runs.

move_before_earlier_run.message: A Run cannot be moved ahead of an earlier Run of the same Plan.

remove_plan_run_active.message: A Run of this Plan is active; wait for it to end or use cancel.

plan_started.message: Plan "{plan_id}" has started and can no longer be re-derived.

schedule_already_active.message: The Schedule is already waiting or running.

nothing_to_start.message: There are no pending Runs to start.

nothing_to_cancel.message: The Schedule is already idle and empty.

no_failure_to_answer.message: No failed Run is waiting for a decision.

prompt_reason_did_not_start.message: The Mower did not start the Run.

prompt_reason_zone_missing.message: The Zone is no longer on the Mower's map.

prompt_reason_stopped_off_dock.message: The Mower stopped away from its dock.

prompt_reason_externally_aborted.message: The Run was stopped from outside Mowing Director.

prompt_reason_superseded.message: Another job started on the Mower.

prompt_not_pending.message: That Prompt is no longer waiting for an answer.

prompt_action_invalid.message: That Prompt does not offer the action "{action}".

nothing_to_pause.message: The Schedule is not waiting or running, so there is nothing to pause.

no_active_run.message: No Run is active (starting, mowing or on hold), so there is nothing to stop.

failure_needs_answer.message: A Run failed. Answer with Retry, Skip Plan or Cancel instead.

prompt_reason_external_pause.message: The Mower was paused from outside Mowing Director.

prompt_reason_recharge_stall.message: The Mower's battery has not risen for an hour of recharging.

remove_plan.name: Remove Plan
remove_plan.description: Cancel a Plan's pending Runs. Refused while one of its Runs is active; never commands the Mower.

config_entry_id.name: Mower
config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.

refresh_zones.name: Refresh Zones
refresh_zones.description: Re-read the Mower's Zones and Channels.

config_entry_id.name: Mower
config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.

add_plan.name: Add Plan
add_plan.description: Derive a step-down Plan from start and end heights and add it to the Schedule.

config_entry_id.name: Mower
config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.

start_height_mm.name: Start height
start_height_mm.description: Blade height of the first Run.

end_height_mm.name: End height
end_height_mm.description: Blade height of the last Run; must not exceed the start height. Equal heights make one maintenance Run.

max_cut_pct.name: Max cut
max_cut_pct.description: Largest drop per Run as a percent of the height (5-33). Defaults to the Mower option.

base_angle.name: Base angle
base_angle.description: Finishing angle relative to the Zone bearing, in degrees.

finishing.name: Finishing Run
finishing.description: Force the Finishing Run override on or off for the last Run (never a single Run).

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Run setting overrides in SI units: spacing_cm, speed_m_s, perimeter_laps, crossing_angle_deg, min_separation_deg, extras.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where the Plan goes on the Schedule: the end (default) or in front of the pending Runs.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start the Schedule if it is idle.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start an idle or paused Schedule.

config_entry_id.name: Mower
config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Abort: cancel every Run and empty the Schedule.

config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.

retry_run.name: Retry Run
retry_run.description: Answer a failed Run with Retry: it returns to the head of the Schedule.

config_entry_id.name: Mower
config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.

skip_plan.name: Skip Plan
skip_plan.description: Answer a failed Run with Skip Plan: the Plan's remaining Runs are skipped.

prompt_id.name: Prompt
prompt_id.description: The id of the pending Prompt.

action.name: Action
action.description: One of the Prompt's actions, for example retry, skip_plan or abort.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Pause softly: the Schedule pauses when the current Run ends, or at once if waiting. Never commands the Mower.

config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.

stop_now.description: Stop the active Run: it returns to pending at the head, the Schedule pauses and the Mower is told to abort.

config_entry_id.description: Which Mower; defaults to the only loaded one.
